subject.title: fix(agent): exit nonzero when gateway runs do not complete

question: Should `openclaw agent` treat every resolved `timeout`, `error`, and `cancelled` gateway response as a nonzero shell outcome, including callers that may currently parse the response and continue?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes a public CLI compatibility contract; code review alone cannot determine whether existing automation should preserve zero-exit handling for any of these terminal states.

options.title: Adopt nonzero terminal failures
options.body: Approve the conventional automation contract after refreshed-head proof confirms timeout, error, and cancellation output remains complete and machine-readable.

options.title: Narrow the changed statuses
options.body: Preserve zero-exit behavior for any status that maintainers consider informational rather than a command failure, and document the remaining contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt nonzero terminal failures
recommendation.body: Approve the conventional automation contract after refreshed-head proof confirms timeout, error, and cancellation output remains complete and machine-readable.
